newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks stay flat by lunch break.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks stay flat by lunch break.

text.p: Thai stocks moved in a narrow range throughout the morning session on Friday and by lunch the index remained flat as investors stayed on the sidelines awaiting earnings results of finance firms, brokers said.
The composite SET index was unchanged from Thursday's close at 701.76 on thin 1.4 billion baht turnover by the break.

"I think most investors are holding their positions and that's why the market was sluggish. They probably want to wait until next Monday when the first quarter earnings of most finance companies are expected to be released," said Bunsom Kesapradist of Asia Credit.

Brokers said investors were worried about the outlook for first quarter earnings of finance firms due next week as they believed the results may not be impressive given recent turmoil and liqwidity crunches in the finance sector.

Siam Makro topped the active list by lunch, falling 6.50 baht to 67.50. Financially-troubled Bangkok Bank of Commerce was up the daily 10 percent limit, gaining 0.30 to four baht and was second-ranked on the list.
Large capitalised TelecomAsia dropped 0.25 baht to 45.75 and Siam Cement advanced eight to 684.
